old_caption: The video captures a close-up scene on a wooden surface where a popsicle is being held by a wooden hand model. The popsicle has a green base with red specks, transitioning into a vibrant red section at the bottom. As the video progresses, the popsicle begins to melt, with the red liquid dripping down the stick and pooling slightly on the wooden surface. Surrounding the popsicle are colorful macarons in shades of pink, yellow, and red, adding a playful contrast to the scene. The wooden hand model remains stationary throughout the video, providing a stable backdrop for the melting popsicle. The camera maintains a steady focus on the popsicle and its immediate surroundings, capturing the gradual transformation of the popsicle as it melts.

caption: The video captures a wooden articulated hand model palm-up on a wooden board, with a two-tone lollipop resting diagonally across its palm. The upper half is a speckled green disc, the lower half a glossy red mass, joined by a brown syrupy waist that leaves a wet stain on the palm. A yellow and a red gumball sit at the left edge, a pink macaron at the right, and a striped cloth at the upper corner. Throughout the excerpt the red portion slowly softens and slumps, its surface growing more liquid and its lower edge rounding into a swelling drip, while the stain beneath it creeps outward. The green half, the stick with its purple-and-yellow wrapper, the hand, and surrounding candies remain motionless under a static camera, the melting already underway when the clip opens and continuing as it ends.
